name: audio_clean_speech
description: Clean speech (VEED): removes background noise from a speech recording while keeping quiet and distant words intact, and normalizes loudness. Accepts audio up to 1800s.

audioUrl.description: Asset URL or a creation `identifier` to clean up. Must be at most 1800 seconds long.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

strength.description: Noise suppression strength between 0 and 1. Higher removes more room tone. Defaults to the validated 0.874.

targetLufs.description: Integrated output loudness in LUFS, between -40 and -8. Defaults to -19.
